Address community review recommendations for release provenance, vault enumeration and CSS specificity.

- **Attestations:** GitHub Actions now builds, checks, attests and publishes `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`. Each attached file has cryptographically verifiable build provenance. The workflow verifies the attestations before publishing.
- **Vault discovery:** list Markdown paths and inspect cached frontmatter once per plugin load; read bodies only for marked planner notes. Later refreshes revisit known planner paths. Newly marked notes, opt-out, note renames and folder moves remain supported. Unrelated notes are ignored on edit and rename. Initial Vault Enumeration remains an intentional, documented capability so notes can live in any folder.
- **CSS:** remove `!important` from the planner container and use a scoped selector; the package audit prevents its reintroduction.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install the three assets below into the vault configuration directory under `plugins/just-simple-planner/` and reload the plugin.

Verify a downloaded file with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner`; the same command works for `manifest.json` and `styles.css`.
